Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays targeting the human mitochondrial glutaminase kidney isoform (target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2146302) where the assay organism is Homo sapiens. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2146302' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return columns: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id aliased as compound_chembl_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id ascending.
